title: SEAT CUSHION ASSEMBLY
summary: Seat cushion (bottom) build-up for all models: the seat cushion cover (trim, vinyl or leather) and foam pad go over the spring & frame assembly. The cover's sewn-in retaining wire and hooks are hog-ringed to a wire on the springs (View A), and the cover's lower edge is clamped to the frame's bottom flange with clips spaced 4 in. apart (View B). No screws or bolts on this sheet.

fastening.note: View A: hog rings [2] clamp wire [1] to the springs of [3]. The cover [7] has its own sewn-in retaining wire and a hook asm. (part of [7], no separate number) that hooks onto wire [1].

View B: the cover [7] edge wraps under the frame [3]; clip [4], with protector felt, is pushed over the edge of the cover and the frame's bottom flange. Start at either rear corner and space clips 4 in. apart (4.00 REF dimension).
Pad [6] lies on the springs of [3] under the cover [7] and is held in place by the cover; no fastener shown (Views B, C).
View C: at the corner the cover's tie cords/wires pass through a slot in the channel of frame [3] and are tied off underneath.
Main view: wire [5] runs across the springs near the center of [3]; how it is attached is not shown.

notes: NOTE: Start clip at either rear corner & space 4 in. apart.
